name: Loan Knowledge Assistance — evaluation set
description: 29 representative tasks covering the real work of the application: grounded factual lookup, multi-document synthesis, conceptual explanation, out-of-knowledge-base refusal, and in-domain loan-math code generation. The identical set is used for every model. A key fact containing '|' is satisfied by any one of its alternatives.

categories.factual_retrieval: Single-document lookup — the answer sits in one KB document.
categories.multi_doc_synthesis: The answer requires combining two or more KB documents.
categories.conceptual: Explanation or comparison of a concept described in the KB.
categories.out_of_kb: Deliberately outside the knowledge base — the assistant must refuse rather than invent.
categories.code_generation: In-domain loan mathematics, executed against unit tests.

fallback_phrase: This information is not available in my knowledge base.

Write a Python function named emi(principal, annual_rate_percent, months) that returns the monthly EMI for an amortized loan using the standard formula. Return only the function.

Write a Python function named total_interest(principal, annual_rate_percent, months) that returns the total interest paid over the life of an amortized loan (total repayment minus principal). Return only the function.
Write a Python function named simple_interest(principal, annual_rate_percent, years) that returns simple interest calculated on the original principal. Return only the function.

Write a Python function named dti_ratio(monthly_debt_payments, monthly_income) that returns the debt-to-income ratio as a percentage, and returns 0.0 when monthly_income is 0. Return only the function.

Write a Python function named outstanding_balance(principal, annual_rate_percent, months, payments_made) that returns the remaining principal balance of an amortized loan after a number of payments have been made. Return only the function.
